answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 41524 Country: India Title: Listening to the holy Quran while driving Question: Please advise if listening to the holy Quran while driving a car is allowed? Answer ID: 41524 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 895/894/N=1433) It is lawful to listen to the holy Quran while driving a car provided one concentrates the recitation of the holy Quran. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
